We are so very proud to announce the official launch of our inaugural credentials to you, our supporters.

Let no brave soul ever die unknown.

We don't sell merch. We issue credentials. These are the first — the inaugural issue of the archive seal, embroidered in California on American-made goods. There will be later runs. There will only ever be one first.

🛡 MADE IN USA — AMERICAN BLANK, CALIFORNIA EMBROIDERY ✦ INAUGURAL ISSUE

The Cap

Black 6-Panel — Archive Seal in Gold
To be set soon

The seal of The Best of America — a private national archive honoring Veterans, First Responders, Community Leaders, and Historic Places — embroidered in gold thread on black, with Heroes Remembered, Freedom for Life stitched directly below it.

A small US flag sits above the back opening, with thebestofamerica.org arched below it. The strap closes with a gold-tone metal buckle — hardware that reads the way a credential should.

Your purchase keeps the archive going — and keeps it free. Honoree profiles are researched and published at TheBestofAmerica.org, where honorees are never charged a fee, never altered, and never removed.

  • Blank: 6-panel brushed twill, black, Made in USA
  • Front: archive seal with tagline below, sized to the largest clean stitch the cap allows
  • Back: small US flag above the opening; thebestofamerica.org arched below
  • Closure: gold-tone metal slide buckle, self-fabric strap
  • Embroidery: standard gold thread, stitched in Lancaster, California
  • One size, adjustable
